title: Sturdy and safe way to hold drink on your sofa.
text:
Sturdy and safe way to hold drink on your sofa.. Sturdy and safe way to hold your drink while you are on the sofa.

With insert, it holds normal-sized glasses. With insert out, it holds coffee mugs.

Very sturdy with heavy weights on the wings. A full glass up to about 8" high is very safe. I wouldn't put liquid higher than 8".

product_metadata.title: CouchCoaster - The Original and Patented Armrest Couch Cup Holder – A Weighted, Silicone, Anti Slip Coaster Stops Spills On Your Sofa, Arm Chair Or Recliner and Keeps Drinks Within Reach, Cool Cream
features: NO MORE SPILLS: CouchCoaster - The ultimate drink holder for your sofa, is the only coaster which securely holds your favourite drinks - hot or cold - on your couch, armchair or recliner (fabric or leather).
WHY COUCHCOASTER: Prevent knocks, spills and stains; Keep drinks within easy reach; Ideal alternative to coffee tables, trays or organizers; Store phones, remotes and more.

COUCH COMPATIBILITY: Wraps over armrests measuring at least 5.5” / 14cm wide with flat to gently sloping sides i.e. is not suitable for skinny / narrow arms. Can also use lying flat, tucked between seat cushions, or draped over pillows and backrests.

FITS MOST DRINKWARE: CouchCoaster works with mugs, glasses and cups up to 3.5” / 9cm wide, incorporating a handy slot for cup handles. The adapter supplied supports smaller drink-ware e.g. bottles and cans up to 2.75” / 7cm wide.
UNIQUE DESIGN: Made of a flexible, weighted, BPA-free silicone body with non-slip tacky base (16.5” / 42cm in length), and incorporating an adjustable holder (2” / 5cm tall).
